reasons.R-ROUNDING: Same source value; the IDF prints SI values to 2-4 significant figures (within 1%).
reasons.R-NEWER-DOCUMENTED: The openstudio-standards row was edited after the DOE v1.4 release (2012-11-13) and the edit is documented; the DOE value is kept as an alternate.
reasons.R-EXISTING-DENSITY: Existing-building density kept: the atlas value is plausible and not explicitly wrong (ADR 0037 section 1).
reasons.R-MIXED-ZONE: The DOE zone spans several atlas space types, so its single value cannot be assigned to one program.
reasons.R-NO-ATLAS-PROGRAM: No atlas program represents this DOE zone.
reasons.R-NO-LIGHTING-SPLIT: The DOE model has one lighting object per zone; the additional-lighting share cannot be separated.
reasons.R-SYSTEMS-DEFERRED: Systems are deferred; BEMGen tests at ideal-loads grade (HVAC, outdoor air, zone mixing, water heaters).
reasons.R-SITE-DATA: Site, weather and cost data are supplied by the consumer at model creation.
reasons.R-COMFORT-ONLY: Comfort-only People fields have no effect on the heat balance.
reasons.R-DAYLIGHTING-ONLY: The lights replaceable fraction only affects daylighting control, which the DOE Ref models do not have.
reasons.R-GEOMETRY-BEMGEN: Plan geometry, shading and skylight placement belong to BEMGen; the atlas carries only window ratios.
reasons.R-NOT-COMPARED: Midrise Apartment was not compared in this reconciliation; it is taken up with the residential work.
reasons.R-HOURLY: Atlas schedules are hourly; a time inside an hour is stored as its energy-conserving hourly mean.
reasons.R-SLOT-CONFLICT: Several DOE schedules serve this slot across the program zones; the program takes the area-dominant one (a tie goes to the first name).
reasons.R-UNCONTROLLED: The DOE model gives these zones no thermostat, so the atlas null setpoint is source-backed.
